I am in the North East, and this sorghum plot depends on the rains, so I will manage it in a simple way that I can afford. I will use some chemical fertilizer if I can get it, but not too much, and I will also use local seed because improved seed is harder for me to access and pay for. I do not plan to irrigate, and I may use a little herbicide to reduce labor, but most of the work will still come from my household with some hired help at peak times.
